But really, I loved this episode. Not anywhere near as good as the first Hearth's Warming Eve episode but still very good. Time for another TwilightShadow life experience story™! That was an interesting episode for sure. I've always felt lucky to have an extended family that gets along well at holidays, and this episode made me appreciate it even more. Our traditions are all mostly the same and generally built around us doing things together (and food, lots of food). But this episode reminded me of all of those times that I've been at another family's house, and their traditions or habits just feel off. Not just in the normal way of these-traditions-are-a-little-different-from-ours sense, but in a twitch-do-these-people-really-act-this-way!?-twitch kind of way. Interestingly enough, they have usually been on the poorer side, or very traditional. This episode gave me the exact same feeling (the second one) as the real deal.

Now I don't know where exactly this factoid comes from (I was at a convention all day, and kind of dead to the rest of the world), but I've heard it said that the pie sisters were supposed to each have a different personality disorder (or something like that).

True or not, this show continues to amaze me with so many interesting characters! While obviously exaggerated to the nth degree (those pie's have teeth like iron), the point was really good. Even if another family/culture/alien lifeform has different traditions that seem objectively worse, it's still something that they're used to and familiar with, and changing something like that takes time, and usually a melding of the two cultures. Perhaps next Hearths Warming the Pie family can join in on some of the Apple Family traditions. I don't know if Limestone will ever come around, but , I think the rest of the family would fit in quite nicely with a little less rigidity in their lives.

As far as the episode's composition as a whole. I thought this one was fantastic. The pacing felt really good throughout, with the only rushed bit being the sudden everything-collapses-before-our-eyes AJ mess-up, and even that was a minor detail that continued the feeling of tenseness between the two families. Lots of good foreshadowing and writing in general. Really love feelsy episodes like this one where somepony just really messed up and there are no buts about it. Ah well. I think I've rambled on long enough. I give this one 8.2/10. I really feel like they nailed the pie family, and the message felt very authentic.
